legacy_regression.explanation: These results are not reported as all-pass. V24 asserts landscape orientation and V32Graphics runs the original landscape Main camera under the new portrait viewport. Both original tests are unchanged. The new portrait suite separately checks portrait orientation, bounds in all three regions, navigation alignment and identical seeded combat results.
